title: Invited talk, Prometheus, London
text: "Accelerating the Aerospace Development Cycle: From Concept to Flight". Invited speaker.

title: Policy-DRIFT accepted at NeurIPS 2026
text: Generative AI for active flow control. A conditional flow-matching model builds the manifold of realizable flow states, terminal reward guidance steers samples at inference, and a lightweight RL policy tracks them. 49% drag reduction in turbulent channel DNS at 37x less actuation energy than the DRL baseline. My idea, carried through with a master's student I mentored.
alt: Drag reduction and actuation energy over time for Policy-DRIFT and baselines

title: Diff-SPORT accepted in Nature Communications
text: Diffusion-based sensor placement optimization and reconstruction of turbulent flows in urban environments. A diffusion prior for sparse reconstruction, with SHAP explainability for where sensors should go. Validated on DNS and on an experimental scaled-down Beijing neighborhood.
alt: Reconstructed urban flow fields from sparse sensors

title: Argonne National Laboratory
org: Research aide, with Dr. Misun Min and Prof. Paul Fischer
text: A latent foundation model for wire-coil inserts in reactor heat exchangers. Ran NekRS conjugate heat transfer simulations over Re 2500 to 15500, then built a two-stage Reynolds-decomposition decoder that recovers the turbulent fluctuations a plain autoencoder loses, with a latent predictor for unseen parameters.
alt: Wire-coil flow, DNS on the left and the diffusion decoder on the right

title: AeroJEPA, now part of NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo
text: A joint-embedding predictive architecture for steady 3D aerodynamic fields. More accurate than three baselines on high-lift geometries with over 10 million surface points, and linear probes on the latent recover lift and drag. Co-developed; the model shipped in NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo.

title: Agentic exploration of PDE spaces
text: A multi-LLM-agent system that plans, runs and analyzes simulations on its own, on top of a latent foundation model. It evaluated over 1,600 configurations and recovered non-obvious scaling laws.
alt: Agentic system for exploration of PDE spaces, overview diagram

title: NVIDIA GTC 2026, invitation-only poster
text: Invited by NVIDIA to present "Fast High-Fidelity Urban Airflow Emulator with Explainable Optimized Sensor Placement" in San Jose. Same month: NVIDIA Certified Professional, Agentic AI.

title: Industry collaborations and a CoreWeave compute grant
text: Spatiotemporal film-cooling prediction with RTX (Pratt & Whitney). alt: Latent foundation model overview: simulations, autoencoder, latent predictor

alt: Flow-matching rollouts of a turbulent field
